name: merge-to-deploy-lead-time-and-gap-reporter
description: Reports merge-to-deploy lead time, commits merged but never deployed, and deploys that reached AWS with no reviewed PR, correlated across GitHub, GitLab, and Azure DevOps. Read-only. Recommends AWS MCP augmentation (a custom source-control MCP) used alongside the connected associations and AWS reads.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on MON at 07:00 UTC
